entries.EN:
A regular plastic and rubber gas mask, used for filtering air from radioactive particles and poisonous substances. Widely used by rookies and veterans of all factions due to its universal functionality. Does not provide any physical protection.

entries.EN: Exoskeleton Mk.3
entries.JA_current: Exoskeleton
entries.JA_new: エクソスケルトン Mk.3

entries.EN:
A military exoskeleton prototype that never went into serial production due to extreme cost and design flaws. It is however produced in small batches at small illegal factories outside of Ukraine. This is a third generation exoskeleton with improved mobility and reinforced armor over its predecessors. Provides excellent bullet and rupture protection with a low level of anomaly protection.
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]FACTION ALIGNMENT: %c[0,170,170,170]None

entries.EN: SEVA Suit
entries.JA_current: SEVA suit
entries.JA_new: SEVAボディスーツ

entries.EN:
This suit was produced by one of Kiev's defense research institutes and represents an excellent alternative to stalker hand-made suits. It is a combination of a bulletproof vest, a closed-cycle breathing system and an integrated system of anomalous field suppression. Due to the perfect selection of materials, it is a definitive choice for excursions into high intensity radiation fields and dangerous anomalous areas.
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]FACTION ALIGNMENT: %c[0,170,170,170]None
 

		%c[0,255,165,0]SHIFT + SCROLL to configure NVG brightness

entries.EN: Stalker Suit
entries.JA_current: Stalker suit
entries.JA_new: ストーカースーツ

entries.EN:
Manufactured by craftsmen within the Zone, it is an effective combination of a light military bulletproof vest and a rubberized fabric suit reinforced with inserted kevlar plates. Provides good protection from weak gunfire though it is highly inefficient for carrying out raids and serious operations in the deeper parts of the Zone.

entries.JA_new: 旅行者のジャケット

entries.EN:
The former owner of this outfit was a tourist who would often embark on long hikes into dangerous areas of the Zone. The suit has been specially tailored to effectively distribute equipment weight. The ample supply of coat pockets and the use of a weight distributing backpack allows its owner to carry around a large amount of gear.

entries.EN: SSP-99 Suit
entries.JA_current: SSP-99 Ecologist
entries.JA_new: SSP-99 ボディスーツ

entries.EN:
A chemical protection suit specially designed to meet the requirements of the Zone's environment. Used by scientific expeditions and eco-stalkers who cooperate with them, the suit features an integrated air-filtering and air-conditioning system. It is heat and electricity resistant, provides good protection from radiation and biological anomalies and is highly resistant to chemically aggressive substances. Though, it is not suitable for combat, as it provides neither bullet or splinter protection.

entries.EN:
A Berill-5M special forces suit modified for the Zone's environment. Includes a PSZ-9a military bulletproof vest with beryllium coating and a Sphere-08 helmet. Is designed for assault operations in areas with high background radiation though its anomaly protection is low.

A Berill-5M special forces suit modified for the Zone's environment. Is designed for assault operations in areas with high background radiation though its anomaly protection is low. The fabric of this suit has been saturated with a streptozoidal lotion, which speeds up the healing of wounds.

entries.EN:
Reinforced bullet-proof vest for officers, based on the "Permyachka" army kit. Is highly effective against bullets, ricochets and shrapnel. Also provides a rather efficient resistance against anomalies. Night-vision device included.
